stem:
Meera sorts four things found in her home in Delhi for her Science class.

| thing | W | X | Y | Z |
| item | iron nail | plastic scale | glass bangle | sulphur powder |

Which things are elements that can be classified as metals or non-metals?

teacher.key_rationale: Iron and sulphur are elements, so iron is a metal and sulphur is a non-metal. Plastic and glass are everyday materials, not elements, so they belong to neither class. Correct pair is W and Z (B). Option D traps a student who treats anything that is not a metal (glass) as a non-metal.
